entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 1. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and the State.

2. This is an application for bail U/s.438 Cr.P.C. filed by the Petitioner in apprehension of arrest for his alleged involvement in the offences U/s. 419/420/467/468/471/120-B/417/34, I.P.C. in connection with Dhenkanal Town P.S. Case No.130 of 2023 corresponding to G.R. Case No.283 of 2023 pending in the court of the learned S.D.J.M., Dhenkanal.

3. It reveals from the F.I.R. that, on 27.06.2017 the complainant purchased a land under mouza Padmalavpur from the legal heirs of the recorded tenant Alati Rout through Registered Sale Deed and the same was mutated in his name.
But subsequently the complainant came to know from online source that the said land has now been recorded in the name of one Antaryami Behera.

When the complainant verified from the office of the Sub-Registrar, he came to know that his land has been sold to aforesaid Antaryami Behera by // 2 // impersonation practicing fraud and in that sale deed the present Petitioner along with others has been shown as a witnesses.
4.
Learned counsel for the State submits that the Petitioner is having one more criminal antecedent to his credit.

5. Having regard to the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioners, nature of allegations as emerged from the materials on record, the circumstances appearing, the seriousness and gravity of the offences, while this Court is not inclined to grant anticipatory bail, it is directed that the Apser Khan vs State Of Odisha .... sentences.text:
Petitioner if so chooses may surrender before the learned S.D.J.M., Dhenkanal in the aforesaid G.R.
Case No.283 of 2023 during the first hour within three weeks from today and move for bail.
In such event, the learned Magistrate shall consider the bail application of the Petitioner in the first hour of the day itself, strictly on the basis of the materials available on record.
In case of rejection of the bail application by the learned Magistrate, the Petitioner may move for bail before the higher forum in the second hour of the same day.

In that event, the higher forum shall consider and dispose of the bail application of the Petitioner on the same day on merit, strictly on the basis of the materials available on record without being influenced by any observation made herein by this Court or presuming it to be a direction in affirmative.
6. The Case Diary be made available to the learned courts below as far as possible to facilitate disposal of the bail application of the Petitioner on the same day itself.
7. This order is subject to verification of criminal antecedents of the Petitioner.
If more than one criminal antecedent is noticed against // 3 // the Petitioner besides the present issue, then this order shall not be given effect to.

However, the learned courts shall apply their wisdom in dealing with the application allowing or rejecting the application for bail keeping in view the gravity of the offence and the severity of punishment.
8. The ABLAPL is disposed of accordingly.
(Chittaranjan Dash) Judge S.K.Parida Apser Khan vs State Of Odisha ....
